challenge.method: Trace an empty list as the left operand with a right operand that would raise if evaluated.
challenge.results: The and expression returns the empty list and skips the right operand. The or expression evaluates the right operand and encounters the exception. The truth test controls evaluation without converting the selected operand to a Boolean.

limitations: The claim applies to the keyword operators and and or. Truth determination depends on the left operand.
